en:
It's close to midnight now.
Tomorrow is a busy day, I should get some sleep.

<CLT=cltMIND>I collapsed onto the bed and
quickly fell asleep.
I need a miracle!

...You pray, right? While you're working,
living, and gambling.
But miracles happen every day.

For example, do you know what the odds
of the earth existing are?

The same as a tornado blowing through a
junkyard and assembling a working car.
That's a miracle!

That's why us being alive on earth is a
miracle!

All kinds of miracles happen every day.
Life is made up of little miracles.

But whenever a miracle does happen, it just gets
chalked up as fate or destiny or whatever.

Be grateful for the miracles that have already
happened instead of hoping for new ones.

If you do that, you should be able to
enjoy miracles, right?
Rise and shine, ursine!

This is an official announcement from the
Ultimate Academy! It's 8 a.m. so wake up!
Oh, he left! Monosuke is so impatient!

He's been cranky lately, so it's making him
impatient.
I...don't like impatient men!
I...WANT-TO-GET-ALONG-WITH-MONOSUKE.

It's a little early, but I'll go ahead and do
the nighttime announcement too!
It'll be 10 p.m. later!

It's too early! Your impatience is trying to
warp time and space!
...So long, bear-well.
Today is the day of Himiko's magic show...

<CLT=cltMIND>But the insect fiasco yesterday, and now this?
Do we really have time to be doing this stuff?

Welp, I suppose I shouldn't think about it so much.
I'll just go to the gym for now.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.

<CLT=cltMIND>I usually slept on a futon at home.
I don't really like sleeping on beds...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>Why all the uniforms...?
They could at least give me some casual clothes.
